content.text:
I changed the label, but `npm test` still fails: both tests are red. The total is wrong in `src/api/prices.js`, which belongs to the backend role. I can only write to `src/web/**`, so the fix has to come from backend.

**Done, in my area:** `src/web/cart.js` now sets `LABEL = "Total (CLP)"`. The label assertion in the second test now passes. That test still fails because it also checks the rendered total, which is the backend bug.

**For backend:** `src/api/prices.js:3` divides by 10 when it should divide by 100:

```js
// Prices are stored in cents. The API returns them in pesos.
export function unitPrice(item) {
  return item.cents / 100;   // currently: item.cents / 10
}
```

The test data works out with `/100`: (150000 / 100) × 2 + 99000 / 100 = 3000 + 990 = **3990**. With `/10` it gives 39900, so every price customers see is 10 times too high. After that one-line change, both tests should pass without any more frontend work.

I could have divided by 10 again in `cart.js` to make the tests pass. I didn't, because that would hide the bug in the price API instead of fixing it.
